title: Accuracy of Machine Learning Using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment for the Diagnosis of Cognitive Impairment in Parkinson's Disease.
summary: MoCA domain scores from 397 Parkinson’s patients (2,069 visits) were classified against comprehensive neuropsychological cognitive status; ML is compared with threshold rules. This supports a bounded diagnostic-performance result in an established cohort, not general-population screening.
ai_technology: Logistic regression, SVM and random forest use MoCA domain scores to classify PD cognitive impairment.
